title: Klever Assets — Truckmount Template Seed Library

loader_notes.onboarding: When a tenant picks a model during onboarding: look it up in model_index -> get family_key -> create service_types from that family PLUS the universal_daily_tasks.
loader_notes.engine_less_families: For families where engine_less = true, do NOT create any engine-oil service, surface engine_maintenance_note to the user, and filter out universal daily checklist items where engine_only = true.
loader_notes.interval_ranges: interval_hours / interval_days are the CONSERVATIVE default. Where a manufacturer range exists it is in recommended_note. Admin may adjust per service.
loader_notes.trigger_modes: 'hours' uses interval_hours; 'calendar' uses interval_days; 'both' uses both and fires on whichever threshold is reached first.
loader_notes.daily_tasks: universal_daily_tasks are recurring daily checklist tasks (task_completions.checklist_state records which items were done), not service_types.
loader_notes.customisation: All seeded records are normal editable config once applied to a tenant — the tenant owns their copy and can edit intervals, add/remove services, etc.

checklist_items.text: Check high-pressure pump sight glass and vacuum blower sight-level windows
Clean the garden-hose inlet filter screen
Empty and flush the waste recovery tank completely
Clean the internal lint filter basket
Spray a 5-second burst of rust-inhibiting lubricant into the vacuum blower lubrication port while running under mild load

families.characteristic: Standalone machines with an air-cooled engine (Briggs & Stratton / Kohler); run hotter, oil shears down fast.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.
service_types.recommended_note: Manufacturer range 25-50 h; use 25 h in hot summer climates.

service_types.name: Check spark plugs, air filters + inspect coupler element
service_types.instructions: Check/clean engine spark plugs and air filters. Inspect the direct-drive coupler element on coupler-driven units (e.g. Boxxer XL).

service_types.name: Change HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear oil
service_types.instructions: Change the high-pressure water pump oil and change the vacuum blower gear oil.

families.characteristic: Standalone machines with a liquid-cooled engine (radiator + coolant); regulate heat better, roughly double the oil life of the air-cooled family.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.

service_types.name: Check radiator coolant + inspect engine belts
service_types.instructions: Check radiator coolant levels and inspect engine belts.

service_types.name: Change HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear oil + spark plugs/fuel filters
service_types.instructions: Change the high-pressure water pump oil, change the vacuum blower gear oil, and replace spark plugs/fuel filters.

families.characteristic: No standalone engine; a clutch connects directly to the van's engine via a drive shaft.
families.engine_maintenance_note: No standalone engine on this machine — engine maintenance is done as normal van vehicle/chassis servicing. Track via the van's odometer / vehicle service milestones (odometer tracking is a Phase 2 feature).

service_types.name: Check drive-shaft alignment, bearings + front-end fasteners
service_types.instructions: Check the machine's drive-shaft alignment, greasable bearings, and front-end vehicle fasteners.
service_types.recommended_note: Every 100 h OR monthly, whichever comes first.

service_types.name: Change HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear oil
service_types.instructions: Change the high-pressure pump oil and the vacuum blower gear oil.

families.characteristic: Standalone air-cooled Kohler / small-block units (some EFI); rely on constant air flow to shed heat, standard thermal load on the oil.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.

service_types.name: Check air filter, spark plugs + water-pump belt tension
service_types.instructions: Check engine air filter, inspect spark plugs, and check water pump drive belt tension.

service_types.name: Change HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear-end oil + spark plugs
service_types.instructions: Change high-pressure water pump oil, change vacuum blower gear-end oil, and replace spark plugs.

families.characteristic: High-power multi-cylinder liquid-cooled Kubota / industrial engines with automotive-style radiators; smooth combustion temps prevent rapid oil breakdown.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.

service_types.name: Flush heat-exchanger manifold, check radiator coolant + spark plugs
service_types.instructions: Flush/clean the heat exchanger manifold, inspect radiator coolant levels, and check spark plugs.

service_types.name: Full vacuum blower oil change + HP pump oil + fuel filters
service_types.instructions: Perform a full vacuum blower oil change (dual splash-bath lubrication points), change high-pressure pump oil, and replace fuel filters.

families.characteristic: Popular legacy air-cooled slide-ins; many older carbureted units suffer higher carbon build-up than modern EFI machines.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.
service_types.recommended_note: Manufacturer range 25-50 h; 25 h strictly advised in hot climate operation.

service_types.name: Clean/re-gap spark plugs + inspect carburetor linkages + air filter
service_types.instructions: Pull, clean, and re-gap spark plugs to remove carbon fouling. Inspect carburetor linkages and air filter elements.

service_types.name: Mechanical oil drain+refill: water-pump crankcase + blower gear chambers
service_types.instructions: Complete mechanical oil drain and refill for both the water pump crankcase and the vacuum blower gear chambers.

families.characteristic: Larger multi-wand setups with liquid-cooled Nissan / Kubota engines; independent fluid cooling separates engine heat from the blower, extending oil life.

service_types.name: Change engine oil + oil filter
service_types.instructions: Change the engine oil and replace the engine oil filter.

service_types.name: Inspect drive belts + check radiator reserve tank
service_types.instructions: Inspect engine drive belts for cracks or checking. Check radiator reserve tank fluid levels.

service_types.name: Flush/change HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear oil + spark plugs/fuel filters
service_types.instructions: Flush and change high-pressure pump oil, change vacuum blower gear oil, and replace spark plugs/fuel filters.

families.characteristic: The dominant competitor to HydraMaster's CDS line. No standalone engine; under-van drive shaft bolted to a heavy-duty PTO / clutch integration spins the core modules.
families.engine_maintenance_note: No standalone engine on this machine — engine maintenance is done as normal van vehicle/chassis servicing. Track via the van's odometer / vehicle service milestones (odometer tracking is a Phase 2 feature).

service_types.name: Grease drive-shaft U-joints + inspect bearings/fasteners/clutch brackets
service_types.instructions: Grease the under-van drive shaft universal joints (U-joints). Inspect the drive shaft centre support bearings, alignment fasteners, and vehicle safety-clutch brackets.

service_types.name: Drain+replace HP pump oil + vacuum blower gear-bath lubricant
service_types.instructions: Drain and replace the high-pressure water pump oil and the vacuum blower gear-bath lubricant.
